name: Bath Lane Recreation Ground Play Area
text: Roundabout, junior and toddler climbing units, flat and cradle swings, floor games, and inclusive play panel and basket swing.

name: Blackbrook Park Play Area
text: Junior multi-play unit, cradle and flat swings, space climber, trim trail, inclusive roundabout and trampoline, maze, picnic benches and a teen shelter.

name: Crossfell Walk Play Area
text: Junior, toddler and inclusive multi-play units, basket, cradle, flat, hammock and inclusive high-back swings, roundabout, see-saw, sensory pathway and a multi-use games area.

name: Eastern Parade Play Area
text: Castle-themed multi-play unit, toddler unit, cradle and flat swings, see-saw, roundabout, springer and football goals.

name: Fareham Park Play Area
text: Snake and carousel swings, wheelchair-accessible multi-unit, inclusive see-saw and roundabout, sensory play den, toddler unit, hammock and basket swings, multi-use games area, outdoor gym and table tennis.

name: Funtley Recreation Ground Play Area
text: Two multi-play units, cradle, flat, basket and high-back swings, rotator, climbing wall, trim trail and football goal.

name: Park Lane Play Area
text: For toddlers (2 to 5) and juniors (6 to 12): inclusive roundabout, cradle, flat, high-back and basket swings, toddler and junior climbing units, springer, trampoline, see-saw, trim trail and picnic area.

name: Sunlight Gardens Play Area
text: Inclusive roundabout, flat swing, junior multi-play unit and springer.

name: West Street Play Area
text: Outside Fareham Shopping Centre: inclusive multi-play unit with slide, sensory panels, role-play market stall and boat, egg spinner, mini swing and wave rider.
